description: This Java class 'AnnualCompoundingPeriod' models an interest compounding period with methods to calculate interest based on daily or average daily balances, within a specified date interval, for savings accounts in a financial application.

classes.name: AnnualCompoundingPeriod
classes.description: A class representing an annual interest compounding period with methods to calculate interest based on different interest calculation types and periods.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of AnnualCompoundingPeriod for a given date interval and balances.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest based on the specified interest calculation type and period type.

methods.name: calculateUsingAverageDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest using the average daily balance method.

methods.name: calculateUsingDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest using daily or monthly balance methods.

methods.name: endOfDayBalancesWithinPeriodInterval
methods.description: Filters and caps end-of-day balances within a specified period interval.

methods.name: getPeriodInterval
methods.description: Returns the date interval for this interest period.
